headline: 影剧双热：《绿灯军团》《死神》霸榜
headlineEn: Movies & TV Both Hot: Green Lantern Corps and Bleach Top Charts
summary: 今日电影零上映，但《绿灯军团》领跑电影榜；剧集端《特别行动：母狮》引发热议，另有《死神》《航海王》跨影视双榜，本周新片4部，下一站《最后的日出》。
summaryEn: No movies released today, but Green Lantern Corps leads film charts; on TV, Special Ops: Lioness sparks buzz, while Bleach and One Piece dominate both film and TV rankings. 4 new movies this week; next up is The Last Sunrise.
